# MMX

MMX is an open-source, self-hosted trading engine for game economies and virtual commodities. It matches orders; the game server owns player accounts, asset reservations, and settlement.

- [Documentation](https://docs.mmx.exchange/llms.txt): installation, architecture, API references, and integration guides. Append .md to documentation page URLs for Markdown.
- [Getting started](https://docs.mmx.exchange/getting-started.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/awesomepandapig/mmx)
- [Interactive demo](https://mmx.exchange/demo): a browser simulation, not a live exchange.
